$comment: Overlay of the default registry's directx-dxc, adding an osx target. Upstream's supports expression is (windows & !arm32 & !uwp & !xbox) | (linux & x64), because DXC publishes release binaries for Windows and Linux only -- there is no macOS archive to download. That makes dxc unobtainable as a HOST tool on a Mac, which is where the Android AL test suite is configured from: its test shaders are compiled to SPIR-V at build time by dxc running on the host, resolved against VCPKG_HOST_TRIPLET (arm64-osx-release). This overlay adds an osx branch that installs a dxc built from source on the machine, found through DXC_ROOT. Everything the Windows and Linux branches do is untouched, so those two configurations still install the exact same upstream archives, and the port-version bump above upstream's is what makes vcpkg treat this as a distinct package. Delete this overlay the day upstream ships macOS binaries. port-version 2 (2026-09-08): the osx branch also installs headers -- dxc's own four plus d3d12shader.h, d3dcommon.h and the five wsl/ MIDL stubs out of the DirectX-Headers submodule -- because ShaderCompiler's Vulkan back end is now built on macOS and links dxcompiler rather than only shelling out to the driver, and it drops Microsoft::DXIL from the compiler target's INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES because a source build has no libdxil.dylib to link. vcpkg does not hash DXC_ROOT or DXC_SOURCE_ROOT, so any further change to what this branch installs needs another port-version bump by hand or the binary cache serves the old package.
name: directx-dxc
